requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:24-46 registers password.request, password.email (throttle:6,1), password.reset, password.update in the guest group and verification.verify with auth+signed+throttle:6,1; PasswordResetLinkController.php:154-166 validates the e-mail, sends the link and always redirects back with passwords.sent; NewPasswordController.php:105-123 validates token/e-mail/password, force-fills password + remember_token, fires PasswordReset and redirects to '/'; config/mail.php:210-218 sets mail.markdown.theme=pegafila and pegafila.css:587-594 gives the action button #0f7490; phpunit.xml:249-252 pins APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE; .env.example:1-14 updated. Only gap in evidence: lang/pt_BR.json:556-559,801-804 adds the two subjects but the translated reset body/'having trouble clicking' sub-copy required by req. 3 is not visible in the diff.

conventions.evidence: The project's test-first rule ('No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test') is not followed - no test file appears anywhere in change.diff. Docs are not synced (no CHANGELOG/docs edit). NewPasswordController.php:95-103 keeps validation for three fields plus the shared Password rule inline where conventions ask for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields. Otherwise conventions are respected: standard controller layout, inline validation for the one-field form, {{ }} escaping, no service/repository layer.

security.evidence: No {!! !!} in either view; e-mail and password input validated server-side (PasswordResetLinkController.php:156-158, NewPasswordController.php:95-103); VerifyEmailController.php:42-46 rejects a mismatched id/email hash with abort(403) using hash_equals; signed + throttle middleware on verification.verify (routes/web.php:46-48); forgot-password always returns the same status so account existence is not leaked (PasswordResetLinkController.php:163-165); forceFill is limited to fixed keys (NewPasswordController.php:108-111); no secrets or debug output.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no files under tests/ (680-line diff: only .env.example, two controllers, one Auth controller, User, config/mail.php, lang/pt_BR.json, phpunit.xml, two views, theme CSS, routes/web.php). No test covers the reset flow, the enumeration-safe status, token/password validation, the 403 verification path, or the pt_BR mail rendering.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the framework instead of rebuilding it: Password::sendResetLink/Password::reset (PasswordResetLinkController.php:163, NewPasswordController.php:105), the stock ResetPassword/VerifyEmail notifications implied by the contract, PasswordRule::min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers(), and Laravel's standard markdown 'paths' config (config/mail.php:213-215). Controllers are 33-63 lines, no service layer, no speculative abstractions.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with docblocks (PasswordResetLinkController.php:143-150, NewPasswordController.php:79-93), clear names, sibling-style controllers. One inconsistency: resources/views/auth/reset-password.blade.php:334 hardcodes 'Confirmar senha' while every other label uses __().

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task (routes, controllers, views, theme CSS, lang, config, phpunit pins, User MustVerifyEmail at app/Models/User.php:187). The only extra is the hardcoded APP_KEY at phpunit.xml:249, beyond the three pins the task lists; no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests for the new password-reset endpoints, the enumeration-safe status flash, token/password validation, the 403 verification path or the pt_BR mail output, which violates the project's mandatory test-first gate.

Only the two notification subjects are added, so the translated reset body ('Você recebeu esse e-mail...') and the translated sub-copy required by requirement 3 cannot be confirmed from the diff (they may already exist in the unshown part of the file).
The change adds new auth routes and mail configuration but does not update the CHANGELOG or docs in the same change, contrary to the keep-docs-in-sync convention.
Validation for three fields plus the reusable Password rule is inline, while the conventions call for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two simple fields.
The password-confirmation label is hardcoded in Portuguese while every other label in the view uses __(), making the template inconsistent.
A hardcoded APP_KEY is added beyond the three APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE pins the task specifies.

review.summary: The change implements the pt-BR password-reset request/update flow, the signed e-mail verification endpoint, the PegaFila markdown mail theme and the missing subject translations, reusing Laravel's broker, notifications and Password rule cleanly. The main reason it cannot be approved as is: it ships no tests at all, despite the project's mandatory test-first rule, and docs were not updated. Small nits remain (inline Form Request candidate, hardcoded label, extra APP_KEY).
